message: urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:incomplete: rule: expected a field, a literal or "(", found the end of the rule (at column 14 of the rule)
urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:list_value: rule: "riders" is a list; a rule can use it only in "riders is present" or "riders is absent" (at column 1 of the rule)
urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:mixed_types: rule: ">" has a decimal on the left and a date on the right; both sides must have one primitive (at column 1 of the rule)
urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:on_a_field: on "policy.field.premium" must name an entity, but urn:acme:rules:policy:field:premium is a field
urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:unguarded: rule: "deductible" is optional, so the rule must guard it: write "deductible is present and …" or "deductible is absent or …" (at column 1 of the rule)
urn:acme:rules:policy:invariant:unknown_field: rule: "expiry" is not a field of the entity (fields: effective_date, expiry_date, premium, deductible, riders) (at column 1 of the rule)
